newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Glengarry points to lift in gold find.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Glengarry points to lift in gold find.

text.p: Glengarry Resources NL said on Thursday it was confident of significantly boosting the resource at its Gunga West gold deposit near Coolgardie, Western Australia, following its latest exploration results.
Drilling below 60 metres had intersected multiple zones of higher grade gold mineralisation, the company said.
Intersections recorded from the drilling included 11 metres at 2.26 grammes a tonne from 72 metres, five metres at 3.78 g/t from 82 metres and six metres at 2.24 g/t from 63 metres, the company said.
